answer: Because the garden salt is published after the wander checkpoint, the grove audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 21 keys thus pays for 21 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 76 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
